# MTTI Eldoret - Masomotele Technical Training Institute

## Organization
- **Name:** Masomotele Technical Training Institute (MTTI)
- **Location:** Eldoret, Kenya
- **Website:** https://masomoteletraining.co.ke
- **Email:** Contact via website form or WhatsApp

## About
MTTI Eldoret is a TVETA-accredited technical training institute offering courses in:
- Computer Applications
- Web Design
- Cybersecurity
- Nursing & Healthcare
- Phone Repair
- And more

## Key Services
- Professional skills training
- Job-focused curriculum
- Industry partnerships
- Certificate programs
- WhatsApp enrollment

## Course Categories
- Computer & IT Skills
- Healthcare (Nursing Assistant)
- Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
- Web Development
- Digital Marketing
- Python Programming
- And specialized technical courses

## Enrollment
- Enroll via WhatsApp for quick support
- Flexible course durations
- Affordable course fees (KES 15,000+)
- Payment plans available

## Contact
For inquiries about courses, enrollment, or partnerships, contact MTTI Eldoret directly through the website.
